entities.summary: The Democratic Movement for Change, commonly known by its Hebrew abbreviation Dash, was a liberal and Zionist political party in Israel. Formed in 1976 by a group that included several prominent public figures who were not career politicians, it was regarded as a centrist party. Although it achieved initial electoral success, it was dissolved in 1978 after two years of activity.
